velocita.name: Pace
velocita.label: Pace / Short sprint
velocita.description: Quickness over the first metres, acceleration and reactivity in the attacking and defensive transitions typical of five-a-side.

fisico.name: Physical
fisico.label: Physical / Shielding and tackles
fisico.description: Strength in rough challenges, holding up in one-on-one physical duels and shielding the ball with your back to goal.

resistenza.name: Stamina
resistenza.label: Stamina / Breath
resistenza.description: Lung capacity to keep an intense pace for the whole 60 minutes without fading at the end of the match.

tiro.name: Shooting
tiro.label: Shooting / Finishing
tiro.description: Accuracy, power with the laces or inside of the foot, sudden toe-pokes and composure in front of the goalkeeper.

passaggio.name: Passing
passaggio.label: Passing / Lay-offs
passaggio.description: Accuracy in quick one-touch lay-offs, through balls along the ground and switches of play in tight spaces.

dribbling.name: Dribbling
dribbling.label: Dribbling / Close control
dribbling.description: Agility with the sole, sudden changes of direction and the ability to beat a player to create an overload.

difesa.name: Defending
difesa.label: Defending / 1v1
difesa.description: Timing when doubling up, reading the opponents' passing lanes, interceptions and solidity in defensive one-on-ones.

visione.name: Vision
visione.label: Vision / Tactics
visione.description: Tactical intelligence, sense of preventive positioning, ability to anticipate how play develops and set the tempo.

android: Open Club Soccer with Google Chrome.
Tap the three dots at the top right and choose "Add to Home screen" (or "Install app").
Open the app from the icon that appeared on the Home screen.
Come back here, tap "Turn on notifications on this phone" and then "Allow".
If you denied by mistake: phone Settings → Apps → Chrome (or Club Soccer) → Notifications → turn on.
ios: You need an iPhone with iOS 16.4 or later (Settings → General → About).
Open Club Soccer with Safari (not with other apps or browsers).
Tap the Share button (the square with the arrow pointing up) and choose "Add to Home Screen".
Open the app ONLY from the icon on the Home Screen: on iPhone notifications only work this way.
From the app opened that way, come back here, tap "Turn on notifications on this phone" and then "Allow".
If you denied by mistake: Settings → Notifications → Club Soccer → Allow Notifications.

formSettings.goalsHelpFixed: {min}+ goals in a match +{pts} (defenders and goalkeeper from the first goal); penalty saved +{save}.
formSettings.goalsHelp: {min}+ goals in a match +{pts}; defenders from the first goal.
formSettings.mvpHelp: Match MVP +{mvp}; the others from {votes} votes up +{vote} per vote.
formSettings.resultsHelp: Win +{win}, draw 0, loss −{loss} for all 5 of the team.
formSettings.keeperHelp: How the club plays in goal: it changes team balancing and the pitch.
formSettings.fixedNote: Fixed: two goalkeepers among the 10 go one per team; the goalkeeper gets the bonus from the first goal and saved penalties count.
formSettings.rotationNote: Rotating (e.g. every 5 minutes): no fixed goalkeeper, on the pitch the goal spot is "GOAL ↻" and teams are balanced without looking for a goalkeeper.
formSettings.title: Players' current form
formSettings.on: On: based on the last {n} matches, players go a little up or down in all ratings and in team balancing.
formSettings.off: Off: only the values written in each player's card count.
formSettings.legend: Legend: how current form is calculated
formSettings.p1: Match MVP (chosen by the admin when closing): +{mvp}. So even a defender who doesn't score can go up.
formSettings.p2: Players' MVP votes, from {votes} votes up: +{vote} per vote (2 votes +0.2 · 3 votes +0.3 · 5 votes +0.5). For the MVP the +{mvp} applies instead of the votes.
formSettings.p3: {min} or more goals in the same match: +{pts}. Players whose role is Defender (in the player card) get it from the first goal, because they rarely score. With a fixed goalkeeper the same applies to the Goalkeeper role.
formSettings.p4: Penalty saved (fixed goalkeeper only, entered at the end of the match): +{save} each, at most +{max} per match. Counts with the Goals switch.
formSettings.p5: Result: win +{win}, draw 0, loss −{loss}, for all 5 of the team. The margin doesn't count (5-4 or 10-2 is the same).
formSettings.p6: Points of the same match add up: a player who loses but is MVP gets −0.2 + 1 = +0.8.
formSettings.p7: Each item counts only if its switch above is on.
formSettings.s1: It's the average of the points of the last {n} archived matches (a match not played counts 0), from −{max} to +{max}.
formSettings.s2: Above zero the player is 🔥 in form (values go up), below zero ❄️ out of form (values go down a little).
formSettings.s3: It's added to (or taken from) all ratings and the OVR, always between 1 and 10, and it counts when teams are balanced.
formSettings.s4: It's temporary: if no points are made in the following matches, it goes back to 0 by itself. The values written in the player's card are never changed.
formSettings.e1: Marco B.: last match won (+0.2), MVP (+1) and 4 goals (+0.5) = 1.7; in the 2 matches before he lost (−0.2) and drew (0). Average: (1.7 − 0.2 + 0) ÷ 3 = +0.5 🔥. Shooting 7 becomes 7.5, OVR 7.2 becomes 7.7.
formSettings.e2: Luca: 3 losses in a row, no votes or goals. Average: (−0.2 × 3) ÷ 3 = −0.2 ❄️. Defending 8 becomes 7.8, OVR 6.5 becomes 6.3.
formSettings.k1: Rotating (taking turns in goal): the Goalkeeper role doesn't count, no goalkeeper bonus, teams are balanced on skills only.
formSettings.k2: Fixed: two goalkeepers among the 10 go to different teams; goalkeeper goals from the first goal; saved penalties +{save}.
formSettings.allOff: With all switches off, current form is 0 for everyone.
